brief.headline: Cut the ₹8.48 L annual overpay and move to 45-day terms to free ₹15.75 L cash

priceAsk.summary: Drop prices on PET amber bottles to match our best suppliers
priceAsk.target: ₹8.48 L annual saving by closing the gap to the lowest prices we already pay elsewhere
priceAsk.basis: On the 250 ml amber bottle (PET BOT AMBER 250ML/28MM WITH SHR SL 01) they charge ₹8.49/NOS while TPAC Packaging India Pvt Ltd. gives us ₹7.62/NOS — an 11.5% gap costing ₹7.19 L a year on that one item alone. We pay them more for the same type of bottles we buy cheaper from others.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 45 days after receipt

brief.financialLeverage: PIK PLASTICS publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, debt or cash position. Our ₹1.92 Cr annual spend is real money to a private converter, but without their numbers we anchor the ask on hard facts: we pay them more than our best prices, and the open market shows headroom (28 mm caps typically go ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room down to ₹0.65–0.80 at volume). With five strong alternates ready to qualify—including Manjushree, India's largest rigid-plastic converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue—we push firmly on price and terms, framing it as benchmarking to our own lowest prices rather than squeezing a supplier we can't see inside.

evidence.point: We overpay them by ₹8.48 L a year versus the best prices we already get
Their 250 ml amber bottle costs us ₹8.49/NOS, while TPAC gives us ₹7.62/NOS—11.5% cheaper
Market reference shows 28 mm PP caps typically go ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
Stretching payment 15 more days (30 to 45) frees ₹15.75 L cash for us
We spend ₹1.92 Cr a year with them—a material customer for a private converter

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B 65/100)—pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate already on our list

alternates.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd
alternates.why: Listed PET bottle/jar specialist (Pearlpet brand)—direct fit for the PET amber bottles where we see the biggest gap

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader serving pharma—strong, profitable, proven alternate for bottles and closures

risks: PIK PLASTICS keeps their financials private, so we fly blind on their stability—if cash is tight we won't see trouble coming; qualify Manjushree or Pearl now so a backup is warm
The ₹8.48 L gap is real but spread across many SKUs; if they balk, focus the ask on the one 250 ml bottle (₹7.19 L of the total) where the TPAC benchmark is rock-solid
Pushing both price and payment at once may feel like a double squeeze to a smaller private player—lead with price (our data is unassailable), then layer in the 45-day term as a simpler admin change
We have no alternate priced or qualified today—don't bluff a live RFQ; position the five backups as 'we are lining up a second source' rather than 'we have a quote in hand'
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, and we'd like to close a gap we've spotted: for the same rigid bottles and caps, we're paying you ₹8.48 lakh a year more than our best suppliers—let's find a way to bring your pricing in line with what we already pay elsewhere.
